name: Digital Signature for eCommerce Checkout
author: Pluginorbit

sections.description:
The “Digital Signature for eCommerce Checkout” plugin adds a digital signature field to the WooCommerce checkout page. This allows customers to provide their signature during checkout, making it ideal for businesses that need customers to sign agreements, waivers, or provide consent during checkout.

Features

  • Add a signature field to the WooCommerce checkout.
  • Customize pen color, pad size, and background.
  • Choose signature field position on both the checkout page and order details page.
  • Include the signature image in the order confirmation email.
  • Responsive and mobile-friendly signature pad.

Learn More:

✨Documentation
✨Live Demo
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Digital Signature to configure

short_description: Add a digital signature field to WooCommerce checkout page and collect secure, legally compliant e-signatures from customers.
